# MODEL: Two-agent fuzzyCGS with 3 states (s0-s2), matching pennies

# PURPOSE: SL1G_F quantifier alternation and quantitative strategy synthesis.

# LOGIC: SL1G_F

# DESCRIPTION: In s0 both agents play H or T: equal actions go to s1, different
# ones to s2; s1 and s2 loop. p is 0 in s0, 0.8 in s1 and 0.3 in s2; q is 0,
# 0.2 and 0.9.

Transition
0 HH,TT HT,TH
0 * 0
0 0 *
Name_State
s0 s1 s2
Initial_State
s0
Atomic_propositions
p q
Labelling
0 0
0.8 0.2
0.3 0.9
Number_of_agents
2
